summary: National Registry certified paramedic with over a decade of continuous prehospital care experience, primarily serving a well-established local employer. Skilled in advanced life support, patient assessment, and emergency response coordination.

experience.title: Paramedic
bullets: Provide advanced life support on 1,200+ annual emergency calls, including cardiac arrests, trauma, and respiratory emergencies.
Serve as shift lead for a 4-person crew, coordinating scene triage and patient transport decisions.
Administer medications, interpret 12-lead ECGs, and perform advanced airway management per protocol.
Maintain unit inventory and controlled substance logs with 100% compliance across quarterly audits.

experience.title: EMT / Paramedic
experience.employer: a regional emergency medical services agency
bullets: Responded to 2,000+ 911 calls across urban and rural coverage areas as a two-person crew member.
Performed patient assessments, vital sign monitoring, and basic life support interventions.
Documented patient care reports in electronic medical records within required timeframes.
Collaborated with fire and law enforcement on multi-agency emergency scenes.

experience.title: Emergency Medical Technician
bullets: Transported 1,500+ patients between facilities, monitoring condition throughout transit.
Assisted paramedics with equipment setup, CPR, and patient positioning during high-acuity calls.
Completed daily vehicle and equipment checks, ensuring readiness for immediate dispatch.
Trained 8 new EMTs on stretcher operations, oxygen delivery, and documentation standards.
